title: AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.RawModuleScalarComparison.derivedPullbackIsoImpl
statement: For a commutative ring Λ in Type(u+1) and f:X→Y between universe-u schemes, construct the derived scalar pullback comparison from the canonical scalar comparison [def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison], by composing the inverse derived composition comparison, the derived canonical natural isomorphism, and the forward derived composition comparison.

lean.statement: def derivedPullbackIsoImpl (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙ (forget Λ X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ≅ (forget Λ Y).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙ (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
